user.title: sACN Control
user.description: Receive sACN to drive Home Assistant lights, and/or expose sACN fixtures as lights.

inbound.title: Lights controlled by sACN
inbound.description: Pick the Home Assistant lights a console should drive. Newly selected lights are patched from the start channel, in order. Leave empty to skip.

outbound.title: Add an sACN fixture
outbound.description: Creates a Home Assistant light that transmits sACN. Leave the name blank to skip.

error.no_channel_capacity: No contiguous DMX channel span remains on this universe. Choose fewer lights, another universe, or a lower start channel.

data.next_step: What do you want to change?

inbound.title: Lights controlled by sACN
inbound.description: Select every Home Assistant light that should follow incoming sACN. Deselect a light to stop controlling it. Already-patched lights keep their universe and channel; new lights are addressed from the start channel.

outbound.title: Add an sACN fixture
outbound.description: Creates a Home Assistant light that transmits DMX on the chosen universe and start channel.

abort.no_maps: There are no mappings to remove

error.no_channel_capacity: No contiguous DMX channel span remains on this universe. Choose fewer lights, another universe, or a lower start channel.
